title: Ukwemera Kwihishije mu Nkuta z'Ingoro
intro: Hagati mu rugo rw’ububisha rwuzuye imigambi n’ubwibone, umutima uri wenyene ufise ibanga riteye akaga. Uwo musuku wa Allah akikujwe n’ububasha n’iterabwoba ry’urupfu, abona intumwa ihagaze yonyene irwanya ubwami. Igihe uguceceka kubaye ugutera akagere, umuntu ategerezwa gufata ingingo y’ubushizi bw’amanga yo kuvuga ukuri, ivyo bikaba bishobora gutuma umuntu agira ingorane nyinshi.
clues: Nabaye mu bantu b’inkomezi kandi b’ubwibone banse ibimenyetso vya Allah.
Naranyegeje ukwizera kwanje igihe kanaka mu gihe abo bari bakikuje bariko barategura intumwa.
Navuze ku mugaragaro nti: Mbega mwica umuntu ku giti ciwe kubera bavuga ngo Umukama wanje ni Allah, mu gihe ibimenyamenya bitomoye vyaje?
Nagabishije abantu banje ku bijanye n’iherezo ry’amahanga ya kera be n’ivy’Umusi w’Uguhamagarana.
Narababwiye ko uwo mutware nkorera yerekana ivyiyumviro bikeyi gusa, yamara rero Inyuma y’Iherezo ni yo nzu nyakuri.
Nanje nti: Ewe bantu banje, nimunkurikire nzobayobora mu nzira igororotse, kandi Allah yarankijije ububi bw’umugambi wabo.

identity.label: Jewe ndi nde?
options: Umwizera wo mu muryango wa Farawoni
identity.answer: Umwizera wo mu muryango wa Farawoni

trial.label: None Nakoze Iki?
options: Itunga ryirundanijwe imfunguruzo zaryo ziremesha abagabo b’inkomezi .
Yubatse umunara muremure wo kuraba imana ya Musa .
Ukwemera kwihishije rero kwaburaniye Musa ku mugaragaro, kugabisha abantu banje .
Yahinguye inyana y'inzahabu ivuga ijwi ry'uguboroga
Yazibiye inzira y'Umuhanuzi kandi atwengera mw'ijigo ihishurirwa kubera ubutunzi
trial.answer: Ukwemera kwihishije rero kwaburaniye Musa ku mugaragaro, kugabisha abantu banje .

outcome.label: None Ivyo Navuyemwo Vyari Iki?
options: Narohamye n'ingabo mu kiyaga cagabanijwemwo ibice .
Inkuba yaramfashe ndi kumwe na Thamud .

arabic: فَوَقَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِ مَا مَكَرُوا۟ ۖ وَحَاقَ بِـَٔالِ فِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ ٱلْعَذَابِ
verse: So Allāh protected him from the evils they plotted, and the people of Pharaoh were enveloped by the worst of punishment - (40:45)
